children: Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of Australia Andrew Hauser has delivered a series of hawkish remarks to a markets conference, saying the inflation outlook is "materially worse" and the key fears of policy makers have materialized. The comments come ahead of a policy meeting in early November where markets had cooled somewhat on the prospect of a further interest rate rise. Hauser appears to be warning markets that, while a further hike would be painful, it might be needed to get rising inflation expectations down. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
